## Specific task description

Task instruction: Position the smooth bowl with glossy finish at the center of the gray plate for dining.

Task description: Move the glossy blue bowl currently to the right of the gray dinner plate to the center of the plate.

Success criteria: The bowl body is near the center of the gray plate and its bottom rests on the plate rather than hovering above; both grippers are open.

## Execution tips

- Choose a bowl-rim section with ample clearance. Place one finger inside and one outside, gripping along the local wall normal. Contact the walls below the rim with the pads and adjust the opening to wall thickness and clearance to reduce slippage and collisions.
- Confirm the fingers actually straddle the bowl wall rather than merely overlapping in the image. The surface is smooth; test with a small lift and watch for slipping, restoring table support before adjusting if needed.
- When crossing the plate rim, leave height clearance for the bowl bottom and fingers while keeping the opening up. Make pose adjustments in ample space above the plate to reduce bottom-to-rim sweeping collisions.
- Lower slowly during placement and release only after the dish supports the bowl. Withdraw the inner finger upward through the bowl opening as much as possible to avoid catching the rim and shifting the bowl sideways.
